description: Default capability set for every window. Preserves Tauri 2's built-in core defaults, grants the debug-only DevTools toggle so opening the inspector from the webview keyboard shortcut / context menu doesn't trip 'webview.internal_toggle_devtools not allowed' in debug builds, and grants window start-dragging so the borderless webcam-bubble's `data-tauri-drag-region` actually moves the window (NOT in `core:default`).
